svg.desc: CEZ Job Finder icon, route "disc", hand-tuned 16 px rung: whole pixels, flat ink tile 12 at 2 (Mac margin). Paper disc 9 px (r 4.5 at 7.5,7.5). Bird in whole pixels, 9 wide tail to beak: head 3 x 3, breast 4 wide, back one 45 degree stair from head to tail tip, the tip one row above the breast's underside as on the master and 1 px clear of the disc's edge, two 1 px legs 1 apart standing on the disc's lower edge, beak 1 px deep and 3 long - one on the paper, two on the dark tile. No eye. Beak one colour, orange #e57a00: too short here for the two-tone bill (a 1 px yellow row is lost on the white disc).
